specifications.description: CABLE ASSEMBLY,SPEC. Repair/Overhaul/Modification. The item shall meet operational and functional requirements as represented by CAGE 53711 and reference number 6964587. All repair work shall be performed in accordance with contractor's repair/overhaul standard practices, manuals, and directives including drawings (e.g., 5528057, 5528064, 5528078, 5729368, 5729369, 6508778, 6558469, 6558470, 6558473, 6813109, 6813116, 6964418, 6964587, 6964860) and applicable documents (e.g., MIL-STD-129, QQ-B-575, MIL-STD-681, MIL-C-39029). Material must be mercury-free. Marking in accordance with MIL-STD-129 and MIL-STD-130. Serialization required IAW 6964587 note 14 per 6964860, with serial numbers obtained from NUWC_NPT_SerialNumbers@navy.mil.

clins.notes: Provide repair price as Estimated (EST) for the full repair effort. Vendor shall have 90 days after receipt of carcass(es) to complete a teardown & evaluation (TD&E) and submit a Firm-Fixed Price (FFP) quote for the full repair effort. Include cost of new for evaluation. Requested Repair Turn Around Time (RTAT): 160 Days. Price reduction for failure to meet RTAT.
